title: Vampire spawn
html:
Vampire spawn are Undead creatures in various locations in Baldur's Gate during Act Three. With the exception of Astarion as Origin, they are not playable characters.

“
Subservient to the one who created them, vampire spawn are deadly hunters both ravenous and proud.
„
— In-game racial description

About vampire spawn

Vampire spawn are created when a Vampire bites and drinks the blood of another creature. Once spawn are born, they are entirely subservient to their creator. They may only regain their free-will through the death of their creator, or reciprocally drinking their masters blood to become a true vampire.  Astarion is a notable exception to this rule, having regained his free will from being infected by a Tadpole.

Vampire spawn do not possess the powerful abilities of a true vampire, though they suffer from the usual afflictions. They are  hypersensitive to sunlight, making spells such as  Daylight useful against them. They also have resistance to ⁠Physical and ⁠Necrotic damage.

Racial features

Base Racial Speed
9m / 30ft
Size
Medium
Sunlight Hypersensitivity
This creature takes 20⁠⁠Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While sunlit, it has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Ability Checks.
Vampire Regeneration
The vampire regains 10⁠⁠hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight, or has taken ⁠Radiant damage or damage from Holy Water, in which case this trait doesn't function until the start of its next turn.
